explanations.title: Specify the verifier response schema
explanations.summary: The verifier now tells the model to return one JSON object per candidate with a fixed set of fields, preserve each candidate ID, and mark a claim supported only when evidence establishes it. This gives the response parser a clearer expected format; it is an instruction to the model, not an enforcement mechanism.
